subject: Arte
description_pt: Explorar elementos constitutivos do movimento cotidiano e do movimento dançado, abordando, criticamente, o desenvolvimento das formas da dança em sua história tradicional e contemporânea.

components.description_pt: Identificar elementos constitutivos que diferenciam movimento cotidiano de movimento dançado
components.description_en: Identify constituent elements that differentiate everyday movement from danced movement

components.description_pt: Descrever o desenvolvimento histórico de formas de dança em contextos tradicionais e contemporâneos
components.description_en: Describe the historical development of dance forms across traditional and contemporary contexts

components.description_pt: Analisar como formas de dança se transformaram ao longo de sua trajetória cultural e histórica
components.description_en: Analyze how dance forms have transformed throughout their cultural and historical trajectory

components.description_pt: Comparar formas de dança tradicionais e contemporâneas mediante exame crítico de seu desenvolvimento
components.description_en: Compare traditional and contemporary dance forms using critical examination of their development
components.cc_component_description: Compare the treatment of a theme or character type between a modern fiction work and its mythological or traditional source

cc_matches.description: Analyze how a modern work of fiction draws on themes, patterns of events, or character types from myths, traditional stories, or religious works such as the Bible, including describing how the material is rendered new.
